# Motion Stagger List

Report rows that animate in one after another the first time the list scrolls into view: rise, slide, scale or blur. Each row has icon, title, description, meta text and an optional link.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_MOTION_STAGGER_LIST` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/motionStaggerList` |
| Modes | report (multiple rows) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.0 |

Each query row is one list item. The entrance replays after every region refresh. Without JavaScript, or with reduced motion, the rows are simply visible.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | Title | sessionStateValue | yes |  | Main line of the row. |
| `description` | Description | sessionStateValue |  |  | Secondary line. |
| `meta` | Meta | sessionStateValue |  |  | Short text at the end of the row, for example a time or amount. |
| `icon` | Icon | sessionStateValue |  |  | Font APEX icon class shown in a tinted circle, for example fa-envelope. |
| `linkUrl` | Link URL | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional target for the whole row, for example apex_page.get_url(p_page => 10, p_items => 'P10_ID', p_values => id). Must be developer-controlled. |
| `entrance` | Entrance | selectList (`slide`, `scale`, `blur`) |  |  | How rows arrive. Leave empty for Rise. |
| `dividers` | Show Dividers | yesNo |  | `Y` | Draw a line between rows. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/motion-stagger-list/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_motion_stagger_list.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
